# Deus Ex Machina Labs

> Small free browser games and free UK money calculators, plus paid spreadsheet templates for UK tax and money records. Made in a home lab in the UK. Calculators and templates give estimates, not tax or legal advice.

## Home

- [Deus Ex Machina Labs](https://dexmlabs.app/): Homepage with the games, the CIS tools and the free calculators.

## Games

- [Skywave](https://dexmlabs.app/skywave/): A daily HF propagation puzzle on a 3D globe. Work ten made up stations in one UTC day. Free, no account, no cookies.
- [How to play Skywave](https://dexmlabs.app/skywave/help.html): The rules of the daily Skywave puzzle.
- [Who made Skywave](https://dexmlabs.app/skywave/about.html): Who made Skywave and why.
- [What's changed in Skywave](https://dexmlabs.app/skywave/log.html): The Skywave change log.
- [Lorenz](https://dexmlabs.app/lorenz/): A daily Lorenz cipher puzzle. Set the twelve wheels of a German teleprinter cipher machine and read the intercept. Free, no account, no cookies.
- [How to play Lorenz](https://dexmlabs.app/lorenz/help.html): The rules of the daily Lorenz puzzle.
- [Why I built Lorenz](https://dexmlabs.app/lorenz/about.html): Why I built Lorenz.
- [What's changed in Lorenz](https://dexmlabs.app/lorenz/log.html): The Lorenz change log.

## Tools

- [Free UK money tools](https://dexmlabs.app/tools/): Index of the free calculators. No sign up.
- [CIS tax refund estimator](https://dexmlabs.app/tools/cis-refund-estimator/): For subcontractors. Estimate your CIS refund or tax bill for 2025/26 or 2026/27, and see which Self Assessment boxes the figures go in.
- [CIS deduction calculator](https://dexmlabs.app/tools/cis-deduction-calculator/): For contractors and subcontractors. Check what should come off an invoice at 20%, 30% or gross: labour only, with materials and VAT left out.
- [Probate and Inheritance Tax calculator](https://dexmlabs.app/tools/probate-iht-calculator/): For England and Wales. Estimate the Inheritance Tax on an estate, with the residence allowance, gifts and the probate fee.
- [Late payment interest calculator](https://dexmlabs.app/tools/late-payment-interest-calculator/): For businesses chasing a late invoice. Work out the statutory interest at 8% plus base rate, and the £40, £70 or £100 compensation.
- [Gift Inheritance Tax taper checker](https://dexmlabs.app/tools/gift-iht-taper-checker/): For anyone who has given money away. See how far a gift is through the 7 years, its taper rate, and the day it drops out of Inheritance Tax.
- [VAT threshold checker](https://dexmlabs.app/tools/vat-threshold-checker/): For sole traders and small firms. Enter 12 months of sales and see your rolling total against £90,000, your headroom and any deadline to register.

## Templates

- [Templates](https://dexmlabs.app/templates/): Paid spreadsheet templates for UK tax and money records, sold on Gumroad.
- [UK CIS Subcontractor Self Assessment Tracker 2026/27](https://dexmlabs.app/templates/cis-subcontractor-tracker/): £14.99. For subcontractors. Log what you are paid, the CIS taken off, expenses and mileage, and see an estimate of your refund or tax bill.
- [UK CIS Contractor Monthly Return Tracker 2026/27](https://dexmlabs.app/templates/cis-contractor-tracker/): £14.99. For contractors. Subcontractors, verifications, deductions on labour only, monthly return totals and deduction statements.
- [UK CIS Mileage and Expenses Log Lite 2026/27](https://dexmlabs.app/templates/cis-mileage-lite/): Free, pay what you want (£0+). Log every business mile and receipt, with totals ready for Self Assessment.
- [Both Sides of CIS Bundle 2026/27](https://dexmlabs.app/templates/cis-bundle/): £21.99. The subcontractor tracker, the contractor tracker and the free mileage log together. £29.98 bought separately.
- [UK Executor and Probate Tracker 2026/27 (England and Wales)](https://dexmlabs.app/templates/probate-tracker/): £19.99. For executors in England and Wales. Tasks, assets, an IHT estimate, the estate ledger and accounts for beneficiaries.
- [UK Gifts and Inheritance Tax 7 Year Tracker](https://dexmlabs.app/templates/gifts-iht-tracker/): £12.99. Keep a record of gifts as you make them, with exemptions, the 7 year clock and the taper.
- [UK Freelancer Time, Invoice and Late Payment Tracker 2026/27](https://dexmlabs.app/templates/freelancer-late-payment-tracker/): £14.99. Time, invoices and who has not paid in one place, with statutory late payment interest worked out.
- [UK Small Business Sales Dashboard and VAT Threshold Watch](https://dexmlabs.app/templates/sales-dashboard-vat-watch/): £12.99. Sales, margin and targets, plus the rolling 12 month figure HMRC tests against the £90,000 VAT threshold.
